verdict.rationale: SerpApi is itself a public HTTP API. It has documented endpoints such as `https://serpapi.com/search?engine=google`, extensive per-engine parameter docs, async submission, JSON/HTML/markdown output, official client libraries, and an llms.txt plus markdown docs for AI consumption. Community users confirm it provides a machine interface to search results. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: `md` to get a markdown-formatted version optimized for LLMs and AI agents
`true` to just submit your search to SerpApi and retrieve them later
